## Primaquine regimens by G6PD status

| G6PD status | Policy on PQ | Additional safety |
|---|---|---|
| **G6PD Normal** | PQ 0.5 mg/kg over 7 days | Close medical supervision and patient counselling |
| **G6PD Intermediate** | PQ 0.5 mg/kg over 7 days | Close medical supervision and patient counselling |
| **G6PD Deficient** | PQ 0.75 mg/kg weekly for 8 weeks | Close medical supervision and patient counselling |
| **If no testing availabe** | Based on risk-benefit assessment | Close medical supervision and patient counselling |

## Notes

Prior to 2022/2023, 14 day low dose PQ implemented without G6PD testing for a long time in Bhutan
